bullets.text: Executed and inspected a supplied Python notebook to load provided records, then edited simple filters and loops with step-by-step guidance.

Under supervision, joined document identifiers to metadata using SQL and checked unmatched records; executed and inspected supplied notebooks to visualize group comparisons, analyzed the comparisons, and documented missing-data handling.
As part of supervised research, wrote Python functions for parsing provided records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples.
Ran supplied NLTK tokenization and word-count steps on document samples, then inspected vocabulary examples with guidance before attempting classification.
Cleaned supplied metadata tables using provided steps with pandas, then plotted record counts with Matplotlib and inspected missing-value summaries with guidance.
